exposure_note: Exploratory: rough values of post-checkup full charges and step depths were seen in a quick probe on 2026-10-13 before registration. Results are exposed-exploratory validation, not blind.

integration.dedupe: within-phase duplicate timestamps keep last row of same current sign; dt<=0 not integrated

step_program.cv_end: pack>=13.95 V, 0<I<6 A, last such sample

ir_corrected.ir_correction: V+R_hat*|I|, R_hat from pulse edge of the same program (visible at measurement time)

epsilon_Ah.basis: assumption: 45 C vs 25 C charge capacity difference 0-0.8 Ah; no verified source in this task

predictors.M3: anchor + a+b*sqrt(t) fit on visible 25C post-checkup charges (t days since CK0); <2 points -> M2; no increase allowed
predictors.M4_main: Q_hat = Q_anchor + beta*(s_last - s_anchor), beta=1, s_last = last visible step depth (main method), s_anchor = first step after anchor charge; CK1 anchor = CK0 100.41 with s_anchor = first step after CK0
predictors.M5: beta fitted by Theil-Sen on visible (Q_fc,j, s_after,j) pairs j>=1; <2 pairs -> beta=1

gates.G1: 8 full charges found; |integral-counter|<0.05 Ah; start in steep tail
gates.G2: >=90% programs located; median 4-cell range <=0.8 Ah; variant change of M4 CK7 <=0.5 Ah
gates.G4: for all eps: M4 MAE and max error < ExampleModel; CK2-7 increment MAE <=0.5 pp
gates.G5: synthetic LLI-dominant: M4 error <=0.5 Ah; LAM cases reported
